QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Eremos's Gift
QuestInfo.0: Eremos has one last thing to give you.
QuestInfo.1: Eremos gives you a medal commemorating your time aboard the Eluna Express, and your journey toward the truth. His and Surana's lessons will always be with you.
